content:
I printed what you sent. Here's how it came out:
fit_coupon:
- the roof over the pocket: loose loops and tangles around the hole; hole partly closed.
qr_plate:
- the clamp: it fits.
- the bolt's head: it fits in its recess.
- the roof the hole goes through: loose loops and tangles around the hole; hole partly closed.

Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged, and I'll print it again from what you send.

reasoning:
The bridge layer over the counterbore has a hole through it, so the bridge lines get cut and dangle. The usual fix is a sacrificial stepped bridging layer: a strip the width of the hole spanning the counterbore in one direction, then a square of the hole's width on top.

I'm working out the bridging layers for the slot: the first layer should leave open a strip as wide as the hole, running the length of the counterbore, so the bridge lines anchor on its edges, and a second layer of the same width sits perpendicular to it.

I'm settling on the orientation for the bridges: the short direction, Y at 20 mm, looks better than running them the full 45 mm along X. Layer 1 would open a band along Y as wide as the slot length, leaving solid ends that bridge across Y anchored on the side walls. Layer 2 would open a rectangle of the slot length by the hole width, so its solid parts bridge 31.9 mm along X, which is under the 50 mm limit.

I'm applying the same two-layer bridging to the coupon's circular counterbore: the first layer opens a band as wide as the hole across the full 20 mm, leaving solid bridges along X, and the second layer opens a square the hole's width. Both layers are 0.2 mm, so the counterbore floor stays at 5 mm total. Then I'll write the shared code.

{"params": {"plate_w":{"value":38,"kind":"world","source":"measured","note":"width of plate the tripod clamp takes (Arca-Swiss width); confirmed fits"},"dovetail_angle":{"value":45,"kind":"world","source":"datasheet","note":"Arca-Swiss flank angle; confirmed fits"},"edge_h":{"value":1,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"bevel_h":{"value":4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"plate_t":{"value":10.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"plate_len":{"value":60,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"bolt_d":{"value":6.35,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog","note":"1/4-20 major diameter"},"hole_d":{"value":6.9,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"bolt_len":{"value":10,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured"},"bolt_head_d":{"value":15,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured","note":"confirmed fits recess"},"bolt_head_h":{"value":5,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured"},"cb_w":{"value":20,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"cb_depth":{"value":5.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_len":{"value":25,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"layer_h":{"value":0.2,"kind":"design","source":"asked","note":"printer layer height; sets the thickness of each sacrificial bridging step"},"cam_socket_depth":{"value":null,"kind":"world","source":"unknown"},"coupon_len":{"value":22,"kind":"design","source":"design"}}, "parts": [{"id":"qr_plate","role":"final","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"wide (tripod-side) face on the bed, no supports","use_orientation":"same way up: bottom face in the tripod clamp, camera on top","code":"import math
def build(p):
    w=p.plate_w; L=p.plate_len; t=p.plate_t; e=p.edge_h; b=p.bevel_h
    inset=b/math.tan(math.radians(p.dovetail_angle))
    pts=[(-w/2,0),(w/2,0),(w/2,e),(w/2-inset,e+b),(w/2-inset,t),(-w/2+inset,t),(-w/2+inset,e+b),(-w/2,e)]
    body=cq.Workplane('YZ').polyline(pts).close().extrude(L).translate((-L/2,0,0))
    cbL=p.slot_len+p.cb_w
    hL=p.slot_len+p.hole_d
    lh=p.layer_h
    z1=p.cb_depth
    cb=cq.Workplane('XY').slot2D(cbL,p.cb_w).extrude(z1)
    # bridge step 1: open band hL long (X) across the full counterbore width (Y); the solid ends bridge 20 mm in Y
    s1=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z1).rect(hL,p.cb_w+2).extrude(lh)
    s1=s1.intersect(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z1).slot2D(cbL,p.cb_w).extrude(lh))
    # bridge step 2: open rectangle hL x hole_d; the solid sides bridge in X over the band from step 1
    s2=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z1+lh).rect(hL,p.hole_d).extrude(lh)
    hole=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z1).slot2D(hL,p.hole_d).extrude(t)
    body=body.cut(cb).cut(s1).cut(s2).cut(hole)
    body=body.edges('|X and >Z').chamfer(0.6)
    return body
"},{"id":"fit_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"wide face on the bed","use_orientation":"test the bridged hole and the bolt in the camera","code":"import math
def build(p):
    w=p.plate_w; L=p.coupon_len; t=p.plate_t; e=p.edge_h; b=p.bevel_h
    inset=b/math.tan(math.radians(p.dovetail_angle))
    pts=[(-w/2,0),(w/2,0),(w/2,e),(w/2-inset,e+b),(w/2-inset,t),(-w/2+inset,t),(-w/2+inset,e+b),(-w/2,e)]
    body=cq.Workplane('YZ').polyline(pts).close().extrude(L).translate((-L/2,0,0))
    lh=p.layer_h; z1=p.cb_depth
    cb=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.cb_w/2).extrude(z1)
    s1=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z1).rect(p.cb_w+2,p.hole_d).extrude(lh)
    s1=s1.intersect(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z1).circle(p.cb_w/2).extrude(lh))
    s2=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=z1+lh).rect(p.hole_d,p.hole_d).extrude(lh)
    hole=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.hole_d/2).extrude(t)
    return body.cut(cb).cut(s1).cut(s2).cut(hole)

Hand-tight only. Slide it along the slot to balance the camera first.","parts":["qr_plate"],"hardware":["bolt"]},{"n":"5","text":"Drop the plate into the open tripod clamp and tighten the knob.
